lore.bio:
Crypto specializes in secrets. A brilliant hacker and encryption expert, he uses aerial drones to spy on his opponents in the Apex Arena without being seen. He also has a secret of his own: he joined the Apex Games to find the people who framed him for murder.
An orphan abandoned at a young age, Tae Joon escaped a life of squalor by becoming a computer engineer for the Mercenary Syndicate, along with his foster sister, Mila Alexander. One day, Tae Joon and Mila stumbled upon an algorithm that could predict the result of any Apex Games match, hidden away in the Games’ own computer systems. That caught the attention of the wrong people - the next day, Mila disappeared, and Tae Joon was forced to into hiding after he was framed for her murder. 
He’s now joined the Games to clear his name, because sometimes the spotlight is the best place to hide. Along the way, he's uncovered hints of a conspiracy greater than even he predicted - and maybe greater than he can conquer alone.

For more information on Crypto's story, see Crypto (character).

passive.name: Neurolink
passive.description: Crypto and his teammates see what his Surveillance Drone detects up to a long range, with Threat Vision.

tactical.name: Surveillance Drone
tactical.description: Deploy an aerial camera drone that can remotely interact with Survey Beacons, Respawn Beacons, and ally Banner cards. Primary weapons will automatically reload while in drone view. Pressing the Tactical button causes Crypto to send the Drone flying in a straight line in the direction of Crypto's view for a few seconds. If thrown to a wall (or other geo), the Drone will hit the wall and re-orient itself so that it's facing away from the wall.

ultimate.name: Drone EMP
ultimate.description: Charge up an EMP from your drone. The blast deals 50 shield damage, slows players, and destroys traps. After using EMP, Crypto is prevented from Power Coupling for 5 seconds.

details: [Tactical] Nerf -> Prevent Power Coupling for 5s after EMP, Reduced charge gained from scanning players from 10 to 5
[Passive] Buff -> Crypto gains long range Threat Vision while piloting his drone. Satellite Imagery incorporated into base kit.
[Tactical] Adjust -> Reduced time to launch drone from 1.3 to 0.7s. Reduced time to reenter drone from 0.4 to 0.2s. Reduced animation frame that Crypto reenters drone from 7 to 2.
[Perks] Adjust -> Two new upgrades to replace Off the Grid and Satellite Imagery: Ally.MoveTo(), Power Coupling
[Tactical] Buff -> EMP: once again destroys Gibraltar’s Dome of Protection
[Passive] Nerf -> Surveillance Drone : now takes ring damage (10% per ring tick)

[Perks] Adjust -> Off the Grid : players within 20m of Crypto will now be able to spot a faint cloaking “flicker” effect every 1.5s to help identify hidden Cryptos nearby, cloaked audio range and volume have been increased
[Passive] Buff -> Surveillance Drone: cooldown decreased to 30s.
[Perks] Adjust -> NEW: It’s called Off the Grid: Crypto becomes cloaked when in drone
[Perks] Buff -> Improved Satellite Imagery: Ult now scans anyone it hits for 4s and will track through walls
[Perks] Buff -> Neurolink: Network Traffic upgrade now integrated into base kit
[Perks] Adjust -> Upgrades: NEW Quick Ping: improved drone handling (faster accel/decel)
[Passive] Adjust -> Neurolink: increased data collection range.
[Ultimate] Nerf -> Surveillance Drone: reduced drone health and damage output.
[Base] Adjust -> The deployment of the Drone has received a rework.
[Base] Buff -> Pressing the Tactical button causes Crypto to send the Drone flying in a straight line in the direction of Crypto's view for a few seconds.
[Base] Buff -> If thrown to a wall (or other geo), the Drone will hit the wall and re-orient itself so that it's facing away from the wall.
[Base] Adjust -> Crypto no longer immediately accesses Drone View after deploying his Drone in this way.
[Base] Buff -> Pressing and holding the [Tactical] button will launch the Drone forward in the same way, but then Crypto will immediately access Drone View.
[Base] Buff -> Added gamestate (e.g. Ring information, round timers), minimap, killfeed, team status, and ping information to the Drone's HUD.
[Base] Adjust -> Repurposed the Drone HUD's old Crypto health/shield presentation into displaying the health of the Drone itself.
[Base] Buff -> Survey Beacon markers are now displayed in-world while piloting the Drone (same as when controlling Crypto himself).
[Perks] Nerf -> Reduced Drone health from 60 -> 50.
[Base] Adjust -> The HUD marker for the Drone has been tweaked to increase visibility.
[Base] Buff -> The HUD marker for the Drone is now always displayed on-screen while the Drone is deployed (instead of only when the Drone was off-screen).
[Perks] Fix -> Fix for bug when Crypto's animation would glitch after using a finisher while in death protection.
[Perks] Fix -> Fix for cases where Crypto can throw out multiple drones.
[Surveillance Drone] Fix -> Removed the ability to stick Arc Stars to friendly drones.
[Surveillance Drone] Buff -> Crypto’s animation to bring out his drone is no longer skippable by throwing a Holo-Spray.
[Reloading Mastiff Shotgun and 30-30 Repeater] Fix -> Reloading the Mastiff Shotgun and 30-30 Repeater will no longer be faster while in Crypto’s drone.
[Teleport to Replicator] Nerf -> Crypto can no longer teleport to a Replicator.
Surveillance Drone: Fixed an issue with being able to put Rampart’s Emplaced Minigun "Sheila" on the drone.
Surveillance Drone:
Fixed an issue with Hack consuming two Vault Keys if two keys were in Crypto’s inventory.
Fixed an issue with Hack getting stuck within the Trident when deployed as a passenger and the trident is on a ramp.
Surveillance Drone:
Fixed an issue with the drone being able to drop items from Crypto’s inventory.
Fixed an issue with the drone not being able to fit through certain windows.
Fixed an issue with the drone marking friendly Mirage decoys as enemies.
[Perks] Fix -> Surveillance Drone: Dome of Protection no longer can stick to drone.
[Perks] Adjust -> Surveillance Drone: Primary weapons will now automatically reload while in drone view.
[Perks] Fix -> Fixed players getting assist credit when using the drone on a player who is downed.
[Perks] Fix -> Fixed a bug where players could place Gibraltar's Dome of Protection on the drone allowing the Dome to be mobile while in use.
[Perks] Fix -> Surveillance Drone: Fix for cases where players would not receive assist credit when using the drone to scan enemies.

right.name: Perk Niv. 3 Droite
